sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:103

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:103:1
items.html: These Mochin for ZA, and they are the secret of the Ruach within him, etc., in the middle vessels: This has already been explained above, that at the time of the birth of ZA, AVI return to couple upon the discernment of the screen from the coarseness of phase one, which are the discernment of their middle vessels, called the HGT of AVI, whose level that comes out through this coupling is the level of the ten Sefirot of Ruach, as above (page 1128, the passage beginning “In the belly”). See there.
